# OSTT

> Open source, terminal-native speech-to-text for Linux and macOS. Provider-agnostic, scriptable, and bring-your-own-key. Record from a hotkey, transcribe with the model you choose, and route output to the clipboard, files, AI prompts, or shell commands.

- Source: https://github.com/kristoferlund/ostt
- License: MIT
- Install: curl -fsSL https://ostt.ai/install | bash

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://ostt.ai/guide/getting-started): Install OSTT, choose a transcription model, record from the terminal, and set up a global hotkey.
- [Why OSTT?](https://ostt.ai/guide/why-ostt): Why OSTT exists and how it compares to GUI dictation apps.
- [Installation](https://ostt.ai/guide/installation): Install via shell script, Homebrew, AUR, .deb, .rpm, or from source. Runtime dependency setup for each platform.
- [Changelog](https://ostt.ai/guide/changelog): Release notes and notable changes for OSTT.
- [Commands](https://ostt.ai/guide/commands): Full CLI reference — record, transcribe, retry, replay, process, auth, model, history, keywords, shell completions.
- [Processing Actions](https://ostt.ai/guide/processing): Configure AI and bash post-processing actions to transform transcriptions.
- [Configuration](https://ostt.ai/guide/configuration): Full ostt.toml reference — audio, providers, popup, processing defaults.

## Local Models

- [Local Models](https://ostt.ai/guide/local-models): Run offline Whisper-compatible transcription. No API key required.
- [External Engines](https://ostt.ai/guide/external-engines): Connect command-based ASR tools and OpenAI-compatible HTTP transcription endpoints, including local or remote custom engines.
- [GPU Acceleration](https://ostt.ai/guide/gpu-acceleration): Metal (macOS), CUDA (NVIDIA Linux), and Vulkan (AMD/Intel Linux) GPU backends.
- [Daemon Mode](https://ostt.ai/guide/daemon): Keep a local model loaded in a background process. Install as systemd or launchd service.

## Platform Setup

- [Platform Setup Overview](https://ostt.ai/guide/platforms): Global hotkey setup overview for all supported platforms.
- [macOS Setup](https://ostt.ai/guide/platforms/macos): Shortcuts.app hotkey setup on macOS.
- [Omarchy / Hyprland Setup](https://ostt.ai/guide/platforms/hyprland): Keybinding and window rules on Hyprland.
- [GNOME Setup](https://ostt.ai/guide/platforms/gnome): Custom Shortcuts setup on GNOME.
- [KDE Plasma Setup](https://ostt.ai/guide/platforms/kde): Custom Shortcuts setup on KDE Plasma.

## Reference

- [Providers and Models](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers): All supported cloud providers (OpenAI, Deepgram, Groq, DeepInfra, AssemblyAI, Berget, ElevenLabs, Mistral) and local Whisper models. Configuration options per provider.
- [OpenAI](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/openai): OpenAI transcription models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [Deepgram](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/deepgram): Deepgram Nova transcription models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [Groq](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/groq): Groq Whisper transcription models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [DeepInfra](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/deepinfra): DeepInfra speech-recognition models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [AssemblyAI](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/assemblyai): AssemblyAI Universal transcription models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [Berget](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/berget): Berget-hosted Whisper transcription models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [ElevenLabs](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/elevenlabs): ElevenLabs Scribe transcription models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [Mistral](https://ostt.ai/reference/providers/mistral): Mistral Voxtral transcription models and configuration options for OSTT.
- [Troubleshooting](https://ostt.ai/guide/troubleshooting): Solutions for common issues — audio input, transcription failures, clipboard, popup, PATH, and architecture.

- [OpenAI Whisper CLI](https://ostt.ai/lp/openai-whisper-cli): Use OpenAI Whisper transcription from the terminal with OSTT.
- [GPT-4o Transcribe Linux](https://ostt.ai/lp/gpt-4o-transcribe-linux): Use OpenAI GPT-4o transcription models from a Linux terminal workflow.

- [Groq Whisper CLI](https://ostt.ai/lp/groq-whisper-cli): Use Groq Whisper transcription from the terminal with OSTT.
- [AssemblyAI CLI Linux](https://ostt.ai/lp/assemblyai-cli-linux): Use AssemblyAI transcription from a Linux terminal workflow.
- [Berget Whisper Svenska](https://ostt.ai/lp/berget-whisper-svenska): Swedish Whisper transcription with Berget-hosted models and OSTT.

- [Mistral Voxtral CLI](https://ostt.ai/lp/mistral-voxtral-cli): Use Mistral Voxtral transcription from the terminal with OSTT.
